links.passage: Automatic irrigation is a promising technology to increase the farm irrigation management of agricultural crops for sustainable production (Osroosh et al. 2016; Piao et al. 2010; Webb et al. 2010; Beare and Heaney 2002; McBratney et al. 2005).
supporting_passages: Osroosh et al. established a theoretical CWSI algorithm to irrigate the apple trees automatically (Osroosh et al. 2015).
The CWSI acquired from UAV thermal cameras would be optimized for real-time scheduling of irrigation.
links.inference_note: The paragraph defines automatic irrigation as CWSI-algorithm-driven real-time irrigation scheduling, and the cited sentence claims this scheduling improves irrigation management for sustainable crop production.
